rule:
# run-operation — SIE Operator abstract mechanism
#
# Declares the operator's input/output ports for wiring.
# Client mechanisms wire an Effector to this mechanism's Receptor
# via an Interaction to declare operability by this operator.
#
# Actual operation execution is handled natively by OperationService.

trigger = sys.receive("OperationRequest")
sys.effect("OperationResult", trigger)
